load_embeddings: load pretrained word embeddings from text, PyTorch, or fastText binary files into a dictionary and tensor
export_embeddings: export source and target word embeddings to text or PyTorch binary files for later use
initialize_exp: initialize a new experiment by setting random seeds, creating directories, and configuring a logger
get_nn_avg_dist: compute the average distance of k nearest neighbors for query embeddings using Faiss or PyTorch
normalize_embeddings: normalize embeddings by centering them around zero mean or re-normalizing to unit vector norms
